quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 371,603.01 ten-thousand, up 9.69% year over year (2024: RMB 338,761.17 ten-thousand), mainly from higher 300mm wafer revenue; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB 150,750.66 ten-thousand (2024 loss: RMB 97,053.71 ten-thousand); net loss excluding non-recurring items RMB 177,428.43 ten-thousand; operating cash flow -RMB 55,923.98 ten-thousand. The company says 300mm wafer sales volume grew nearly 50% a year on average over 2023-2025, but cyclical swings and fiercer competition pushed product prices down, so revenue growth fell short of expectations; high fixed costs during the capacity ramp squeezed gross margin and raised inventory write-down losses. Weaker-than-expected demand for 200mm-and-below wafers hurt subsidiaries Simgui and Okmetic, leading to goodwill impairments of about RMB 4 hundred million in 2025 (RMB 2.8 hundred million for Simgui, whose acquisition goodwill is now fully impaired, and RMB 1.3 hundred million for Okmetic). Quarterly 2025 revenue: Q1 RMB 80,160.72 ten-thousand, Q2 RMB 89,582.55 ten-thousand, Q3 RMB 94,364.43 ten-thousand, Q4 RMB 107,495.31 ten-thousand; quarterly net loss attributable: Q1 RMB 20,852.85 ten-thousand, Q2 RMB 15,800.97 ten-thousand, Q3 RMB 26,474.18 ten-thousand, Q4 RMB 87,622.66 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 371,603.01 ten-thousand (+9.69%); net loss RMB 150,750.66 ten-thousand; Q4 revenue RMB 107,495.31 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue and gross margin by product (annual report): semiconductor wafers RMB 367,918.63 ten-thousand (+10.52%), gross margin -17.78% (down 7.64 percentage points). 300mm wafers RMB 243,858.46 ten-thousand (+15.80%), gross margin -14.99% (down 5.19 points); 200mm-and-below wafers RMB 112,532.58 ten-thousand (+7.49%), gross margin -23.37% (down 9.28 points); contract processing services RMB 11,527.59 ten-thousand (-34.54%), gross margin -22.05% (down 31.41 points). By region: mainland China RMB 267,274.78 ten-thousand (+15.38%, gross margin -15.19%); other countries and regions RMB 100,643.85 ten-thousand (-0.60%, gross margin -24.64%); overseas sales were about 27% of total 2025 sales. The cost increase came from higher volumes and the higher fixed costs (depreciation) of capacity expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm wafers RMB 243,858.46 ten-thousand (+15.80%), gross margin -14.99%; 200mm and below RMB 112,532.58 ten-thousand (+7.49%), gross margin -23.37%

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and volumes at end-2025 (annual report): combined 300mm wafer capacity in Shanghai and Taiyuan reached 85 ten-thousand wafers per month (the Taiyuan 300mm capacity-upgrade project is still under construction); Simgui and Okmetic 200mm-and-below polished and epitaxial wafer capacity above 50 ten-thousand wafers per month and 200mm-and-below SOI capacity above 6.5 ten-thousand wafers per month; Simgui's subsidiary Xinao Xinyi raised its 300mm SOI capacity to 16 ten-thousand wafers per year. 2025 output and sales: 300mm wafers produced 773.70 ten-thousand (+62.93%), sold 641.63 ten-thousand (+27.01%), inventory 182.23 ten-thousand (+221.65%); 200mm-and-below wafers (incl. SOI) produced 385.42 ten-thousand (+7.31%), sold 355.22 ten-thousand (+4.46%) (figures include contract processing). Subsidiary Zing Semiconductor (Shanghai Xinsheng) kept stable utilisation and shipments, with sales volume up about 27%, covering logic and memory processes and all major domestic customers; the Taiyuan plant (Jinke Silicon Materials) has passed quality-system audits by several customers and started volume sales of prime wafers.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm capacity 85 ten-thousand wafers/month; 300mm sales 641.63 ten-thousand wafers (+27.01%); 300mm SOI 16 ten-thousand wafers/year

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 300mm SOI and silicon photonics (annual report): Simgui and its subsidiary Xinao Xinyi continue the 300mm high-end silicon-based materials R&D pilot project for RF, power and silicon-photonics applications; 300mm SOI wafers are in staged technology development, customer sampling and small-batch production. 300mm SOI core products for RF, high-voltage and silicon photonics have completed key technology development and entered volume-production rollout and market validation; some high-voltage and silicon-photonics products are already in small-batch volume production; a 300mm SOI pilot line of about 16 ten-thousand wafers per year has been built. R&D projects: 300mm silicon-photonics SOI (budget RMB 7,000.00 ten-thousand, RMB 1,947.52 ten-thousand invested, sample development / customer sampling); layer-transfer silicon-photonics materials (sample development / customer sampling); silicon-based lithium tantalate heterogeneous wafers for high-speed electro-optic modulators (small batch).
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm SOI pilot line about 16 ten-thousand wafers/year; silicon-photonics SOI project budget RMB 7,000.00 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses (annual report): Okmetic's 200mm specialty wafer expansion in Vantaa, Finland began line trial operation in Q2 2025; Okmetic 2025 revenue RMB 71,362.45 ten-thousand with a net loss of RMB 25,393.76 ten-thousand. Subsidiary Xinsi Juhe's single-crystal piezoelectric thin-film substrate line completed its planned build and is mass-producing and shipping low/mid/high-frequency filter substrates; optical-grade low-drift lithium tantalate film moved to standardized shipments; 8-inch single-crystal piezoelectric film substrate R&D is complete and in volume production and delivery. 2025 subsidiary results: Zing Semiconductor revenue RMB 248,013.57 ten-thousand, net loss RMB 78,650.72 ten-thousand; Simgui revenue RMB 49,815.93 ten-thousand, net loss RMB 30,188.02 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Okmetic revenue RMB 71,362.45 ten-thousand; Zing Semiconductor revenue RMB 248,013.57 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spending RMB 35,388.27 ten-thousand (+32.63%), 9.52% of revenue (7.88% in 2024); 757 R&D staff. In 2025 the company developed 168 new 300mm wafer products and 57 new specifications entered volume supply; it is developing ultra-low-resistivity 300mm wafers for high-power uses, high-spec 300mm wafers for high-performance logic, 300mm dToF wafers for radar and physical AI, and 300mm wafers for AI / data-center applications. 957 granted patents (660 invention patents) at year-end.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 35,388.27 ten-thousand (+32.63%), 9.52% of revenue; 168 new 300mm products, 57 into volume supply

Major projects: Taiyuan 300mm wafer capacity-upgrade project budget RMB 910,000 ten-thousand, 56.55% complete; 300mm high-end wafer expansion project budget RMB 665,400 ten-thousand, 97.05% complete; 200mm specialty wafer expansion project budget RMB 299,000 ten-thousand, 77.38% complete; 300mm high-end silicon-based materials R&D pilot project budget RMB 214,420.80 ten-thousand, 42.28% complete, whose construction period the board extended to December 2026. quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business plan (annual report, company outlook): Zing Semiconductor and the Taiyuan plant plan to keep expanding 300mm wafer capacity and upgrading technology toward more advanced nodes; the company has launched a new expansion project at Okmetic to strengthen its position in high-end 200mm wafers; it will build SOI supply capacity to meet market demand; Xinsi Juhe will gradually release piezoelectric film substrate capacity and has delivered 8-inch samples and small batches. It plans to focus on domestic chipmakers' demand and speed up multi-customer, multi-product qualification, while following new fab start-ups worldwide.
